spine.deviation_notes: The source player would miss the Waking Dream Remnant economy as its OWN resource (a color-streamed pickup meter, made mono-color by Lucid Dreaming) -- we render it as reservation-swap + on-kill fill, losing the pickup-stream texture and the purple-damage-stack ramp. Also the darkness-absorb defensive window (Embrace the Darkness) is folded into a T4 door, not modeled as an active mitigation buff. That build, worse -- not a different build -- so APPROX not GAPPED.
